recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce old notGiven element wording or remove Timing from occurrence[x]; those current details reflect later accepted decisions. issue_request: FHIR-20643 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested MedicationAdministration.effective be renamed to occurrence, old notGiven comments be removed, MedicationAdministration.recorded be added as 0..1 dateTime aligned to Workflow/FiveWs recorded, and the effective-time search parameter be changed.
initial_application: Jira records the change as committed and merged in HL7/fhir b60fb4b7d3fe218dfc65fc253645e4c6c79d4708. The implementation commit 634360b51d added recorded to the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet source, changed effective[x] to occurrence[x] (initially misspelled occurence), removed the old notGiven parenthetical from the occurrence definition, and changed the search parameter from effective-time to date.
additional_context: FHIR-20602 is the Patient Care predecessor for the Procedure half of the quality-measure timing request and explicitly noted Pharmacy impacts. FHIR-24938 later clarified Procedure.recorded only. FHIR-38710 later added Timing to MedicationAdministration.occurrence[x], and FHIR-41380 corrected occurrence spelling in MedicationAdministration artifacts. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current combined branch has MedicationAdministration active in source/fhir.ini, occurrence[x] present and described as the time administration took place or did not take place, recorded present as 0..1 dateTime with FiveWs.recorded mapping, and MedicationAdministration-date targeting occurrence dateTime and Period.
